items.a: Burma Youth Association (BYA) is a youth development initiative founded in 2026, focused on learning, career development, digital skills, community and opportunity access for Myanmar youth.
BYA does not claim registered NGO or non-profit status on this website unless official documentation is verified and published.
Only verified impact metrics should be published with a definition, source, reporting period, methodology, last updated date and evidence link.
Use the Get Involved page to review current volunteer pathways. Roles should only be shown as open when they are actually available.
